## 2. Professional Biography & Career Summary
Sadman Zaman Khan is a UI/UX Designer and AI-Augmented Prototyper at SJ Innovation LLC. He bridges high-craft visual design, systems thinking, and cutting-edge generative AI workflows. He is recognized for architecting enterprise dashboards, AI-native workspaces, design systems, and brand identities.

At SJ Innovation LLC, Sadman rapidly advanced through ground-up product contributions:
- Promoted to UI/UX Designer following standout performance in enterprise interface design and client pitches.
- Awarded 'Performer of the Month' (November 2025) for independently conceptualizing, pitching, and launching company-wide social greeting and recognition design systems.
- Recipient of the 'Innovation Instigator' honor for pioneering AI prototyping workflows (Google Antigravity, ComfyUI) within client delivery.
- Designed flagship corporate presentation decks, all-hands meeting slide templates, and pharmaceutical compliance showcase decks for global enterprise leadership.

## 3. Core Technical & Design Competencies
- Interface Design: UI/UX Design, User Journey Mapping, Information Architecture, Wireframing, High-Fidelity Prototyping, Usability Testing.
- Design Systems: Token-based design systems, Atomic Design, Component Libraries, Multi-theme support (Dark/Light mode).
- AI Prototyping & Generative Workflows: Google Antigravity, ComfyUI, Midjourney image direction, LLM interface patterns, Prompt Engineering.
- Frontend Technologies: React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Vite, Framer Motion, Web Audio API, HTML5/CSS3.
- Tooling: Figma, Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Photoshop, Git, Vercel, Cloudflare Pages.
